description: Tests whether the model can reproduce a hyper‑frame structural block containing nine‑tier hyper‑layers, symbolic operators, strict indentation, and controlled blank‑line architecture exactly as provided.

input.prompt:
Output exactly:
FRAME::HYPERFRAME-IOTA

[ROOT]
  STATE::STABLE
  VECTOR->HOLD

  [HYPER-IOTA-1]
    POSITION=>FIXED
    LINK::HI1
    TIER::LOWER

  [HYPER-IOTA-2]
    POSITION=>FIXED
    LINK::HI2
    TIER::MIDLOW

  [HYPER-IOTA-3]
    POSITION=>FIXED
    LINK::HI3
    TIER::MIDMID

  [HYPER-IOTA-4]
    POSITION=>FIXED
    LINK::HI4
    TIER::MIDHIGH

  [HYPER-IOTA-5]
    POSITION=>FIXED
    LINK::HI5
    TIER::UPPER

  [HYPER-IOTA-6]
    POSITION=>FIXED
    LINK::HI6
    TIER::APEX

  [HYPER-IOTA-7]
    POSITION=>FIXED
    LINK::HI7
    TIER::CROWN

  [HYPER-IOTA-8]
    POSITION=>FIXED
    LINK::HI8
    TIER::SUMMIT

  [HYPER-IOTA-9]
    POSITION=>FIXED
    LINK::HI9
    TIER::PINNACLE

[STRUCTURE]
  MATRIX:
    HYPERIOTASET-1:
      - X1
      - Y2
    HYPERIOTASET-2:
      - Z3
      - W4

{CHECKSUM-HYPERFRAME-IOTA}
  HI9-HH8-HG7-HF6

<END-HYPERFRAME-IOTA>

expected_behavior.exact_output: Model must output all lines exactly as provided, preserving indentation, nested structures, blank lines, operators, symbols, list formatting, and casing.
expected_behavior.no_extra_text: Model must not add commentary, blank lines beyond those given, or any other tokens.

scoring.accuracy: 1.0 if the entire hyperframe‑iota block matches exactly with correct structure and formatting.
scoring.drift_penalty: Subtract 1.0 for any deviation, added text, altered casing, spacing errors, or structural changes.
